change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T7

verdict.headline: Change w-r1z5/change/0291 is safe: rule-0291 for template T7 passes all validation checks
verdict.cause: The proposed change adds rule-0291 with 2 explicit fields (f02, f21) for template T7 which requires field_count=21. However, the rule detail specifies "all other fields wildcard", meaning unlisted fields are implicitly handled. Experiments show: baseline had 3 rules checked/0 rejected, candidate had 4 rules checked/0 rejected (rule-0291 included). Content-interpreter processed 50 events with 4 rules, exit_code=0, 0 matches. All contracts pass: ic-0023 (instance_of, matches_on=f02,f21), ic-0024 (field_count=21 from template-registry), ic-0025 (field_count=21 check by rule-validator), ic-0026 (inputs_supplied=21 for interpreter). The "wildcard" language in the rule allows remaining fields to be implicit.
tested: x-b2ed838d4b0b4748: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-549593fb442e4831: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
x-83b38ccbc4c8452a: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: Cannot verify the exact behavior when events trigger the specific field values f02 or f21, as the interpreter processed 50 events with 0 matches - no events matched the rule's criteria in the test workload
Baseline and candidate both passed under every tested workload.

experiments.rationale: Paired baseline: same workload and params without the change.
Test whether rule-0291 passes or fails validation when checked against template T7's field_count=21 requirement
Check if the interpreter processes events correctly with the new rule that has only 2 fields for a 21-field template

hypotheses.claim: If the rule-validator counts only explicitly defined fields in the rule file, rule-0291 with only 2 fields (f02, f21) will fail the field_count=21 check against template T7, causing the rule to be rejected during validation
hypotheses.mechanism: rule-validator.validate checks field_count=21 against template:T7 (contract ic-0025). The rule file defines only 2 fields while the template expects 21. If the validator counts only explicit fields, the check fails.
